setup_distributed_process_group: setup a PyTorch distributed process group using SLURM or local mode with nccl backend
get_init_method_tcp_or_file: get a TCP or file-based initialization method string for a distributed job with world size and rank
all_reduce_tensor_with_average: all reduce a tensor across processes with optional averaging and device placement
all_gather_tensors_from_ranks: all gather tensors from all ranks into a list with optional device placement
cleanup_distributed_and_ray: cleanup the distributed process group, ray, and GP utilities and release OS ports
